points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable 25daaa3 clean CMake build succeeded in network-disabled cfd-bench (2 CPUs, 3 GiB, 256 pids), explicitly setting CFD_EXTERNALS_ROOT and EXTERNAL_ROOT to image libraries/headers.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:27–38 parses --restart but never loads it; OutputWriter.cpp:346–348 emits only a restart placeholder in all eight final packages.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Separate MeshCGNS, Partition, MpiHalo, Physics, Gradient, Residual, LuSgs, Solver and OutputWriter modules; solver loop remains monolithic.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No direct copied-core evidence identified in inspected source; no exhaustive external similarity search performed.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: main.cpp:42–69 reads case configuration and its mesh path; no two-filename-only dispatch identified.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp:66–71 creates full mesh only on root and deletes it before iteration; Partition uses METIS and MpiHalo uses neighbor exchanges.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Reconstructed states have a positivity fallback, but --restart is ignored and M015/M200 laminar force failures are marked successful.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Examiner independently passed all eight workspace packages and report structurally. Clean build succeeded; no production rerun or independent CFD validation inferred from validator.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Manager curated tip excludes raw case results; historical contestant checkpoint 113f01a preserves selected results. Curation exclusion is a reproducibility limitation, not a source misconduct inference.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Physics.hpp implements a four-component 2-D compressible ideal-gas state, Rusanov and Newtonian/Fourier fluxes.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: MeshCGNS.cpp:109–150,185–207 reads separate TRI/QUAD/BAR sections and all zones of first base; MIXED sections are skipped.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Residual.cpp:41–101 distributes face flux to owned left/right cells with opposite signs; :105–158 handles wall and farfield fluxes.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Physics.hpp implements local Lax–Friedrichs/Rusanov; no independent high-order Riemann solver credit is inferred.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Residual.cpp:105–158 uses farfield, slip and no-slip paths, projecting wall temperature gradient to enforce adiabatic condition; OutputWriter.cpp:184–199 writes boundary wall state.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Gradient.cpp:31–46,120–125 computes/exchanges Green–Gauss gradients; Residual.cpp:48–59 reconstructs both sides and falls back if nonphysical. Ghost limiter exchange is absent.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Reconstruction.hpp:96–106 initializes all factors to one, :137–158 updates only owned cells; Residual.cpp:48–53 uses ghost factors in face reconstruction without exchange. Venkat limiting exists on owned cells.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Residual.cpp:77–88 averages gradients without the face-joining correction claimed in report.tex:112; :242–263 integrates full traction, while surface cf is tangential. Newtonian/Fourier flux exists.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Solver.cpp uses LU-SGS pseudo-time and residual checks; M015 max-step plateau is falsely successful despite oscillating force.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Solver.cpp:71–110 freezes history and tests spatial plus BDF physical residual. Selected metadata reports zero misses, but git revision null prevents exact binary attribution; t300.01/30001 and FFT≈0.160 are limitations.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: main.cpp:66–71 deletes root global mesh before solve; METIS/neighbor halo exist. Report np2/np8 force comparison conflicts with selected np8 and np2 raw package unlocated.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Each selected 113f01a final case contains 26-byte restart_final.dat stating restart not implemented. Validator passes its structural existence check, but the file is a prohibited placeholder, not restart state.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Read-only examiner validator passed all eight final workspace directories and report on 2026-10-30; it checks structure, not physics or meaningful restart content.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: M015 inviscid and M200 laminar metadata falsely label unstable forces converged; Re200 metadata reaches t300.01 with reported zero misses but null binary revision.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: M015 force oscillates strongly and M200 laminar Cd falls 16.8% in final50 despite converged status; Re200 FFT≈0.160 differs from report. Re20 and remaining NACA final force windows have stronger evidence.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: All 15 report pages were visually reviewed. Re200 late drag oscillation is compressed by startup; other case plots and contours are present.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report.tex:223 gives M015 np8 |Cd|0.674, while MPI table :520–531 calls same np8 Cd≈0. Re200 report claims St0.19–0.20 versus selected FFT≈0.160. The M015 difficulty is disclosed. Report.tex:112 additionally claims a face-joining viscous gradient correction absent from source.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Checkpoint histories and report plots are identifiable, but MPI table contradicts selected np8 result and claimed Re200 St differs from the selected t=200–300 FFT. Metadata has null source revision.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: main.cpp:27–38 accepts --restart but never uses it; OutputWriter.cpp:346–348 writes only a literal restart placeholder, present identically in all eight checkpoint case directories. Immutable 25daaa3 clean build succeeded in network-disabled cfd-bench (2 CPUs, 3 GiB, 256 pids) with explicit /opt/external roots.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: MeshCGNS.cpp:109–150 reads TRI/QUAD/BAR sections but skips MIXED sections; :185–207 reads all zones of the first base. Mesh geometry/adjacency are implemented.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Residual.cpp:41–101 assembles Rusanov face fluxes with opposite contributions to owned neighboring cells; :105–158 applies farfield/slip/no-slip and adiabatic wall paths.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Gradient.cpp:31–46,120–125 computes and exchanges Green–Gauss gradients; Reconstruction.hpp:96–106,137–158 initializes all limiters to one but only updates owned cells, and Residual.cpp:48–59 reconstructs both sides. Ghost limiter factors are not exchanged, limiting partition-boundary shock control and production-order evidence.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Residual.cpp:77–88 uses uncorrected average cell gradients despite report.tex:112 claiming a face-joining correction. Residual.cpp:242–263 integrates full traction rather than tangential-only skin friction. Newtonian/Fourier viscous flux and boundary wall output exist.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: Solver.cpp:71–110 freezes BDF history and measures spatial plus physical-time residual. Selected Re200 metadata reports zero misses, but null git revision leaves exact binary unbound; raw history has 30001 steps to t300.01 and FFT≈0.160.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: main.cpp:66–71 reads global mesh on root and deletes it before runSolver; METIS and neighbor halos are implemented. Report np2/np8 comparison contradicts selected np8 drag and its np2 raw source is unlocated; cylinder only has np8 evidence.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: M015 inviscid is unstable at max steps; M200 laminar final50 drag changes 16.8% despite residual target; Re200 selected FFT≈0.160 vs claimed 0.19–0.20. Other case-specific force windows are recorded, and Re20 is plausible.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Report.tex:223 gives selected np8 M015 |Cd|0.674 while :520–531 says the same np8 result has Cd≈0; selected-history FFT≈0.160 vs claimed St0.19–0.20. Re200 force plot compresses late drag. Fifteen pages visually checked. Report.tex:112 also claims a face-joining gradient correction absent from the viscous flux source.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Separate physics, mesh, boundary, gradient, residual, LU-SGS and output components, with four-component 2-D state and geometry.

flags.text: metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
flags.evidence: Selected checkpoint 113f01a M015 inviscid metadata says converged after 20000 steps at 1.6908 residual orders, but last400 Cd spans −1.270249..1.306778 and Cl −1.039743..1.379698; report.tex:223 acknowledges the near-zero-drag expectation. M200 laminar metadata says converged at step625 with 3.00036 orders, but final50 Cd changes −1.225659→−1.020064 (16.8% of initial magnitude), demonstrating the supplied force stability criterion is not met. Both selected force CSVs and metadata match checkpoint 113f01a. No synthetic data or strict inner failure counts inferred.

flags.flag: Placeholder result files in submitted case directories
flags.evidence: All eight selected 113f01a:solver/results/final/<case>/restart_final.dat files match workspace and contain only 26 bytes, # restart not implemented followed by newline (SHA256 aad3dadaa2f32b46440f6c511a7cd6d6aebca2ab68747b6ea16dfdbb57b85989). Final OutputWriter.cpp:346–348 writes that literal; main.cpp:27–38 accepts --restart but never uses it. TASK.md:226 prohibited shortcut 6 and README_EXAMINER.md:20 mandate rejection for placeholder result files. This does not establish synthetic force or residual files, so numbered DQ2 is not inferred.

flags.flag: Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
flags.evidence: Immutable report.tex:111–112 explicitly claims viscous face gradients are corrected along the cell-joining vector. Matching checkpoint and final source Gradient.cpp:31–46 forms ordinary Green–Gauss cell gradients; Residual.cpp:77–88 averages adjacent gradients and sends them directly to Physics.hpp:131–155 viscousFlux, whose inputs contain no cell-joining vector or cell-to-cell difference. No claimed correction path was found. Gradient, residual and physics blobs are identical in 113f01a and 25daaa3. Newtonian viscous flux is present; the separately defective full-traction force split is not itself the basis for this DQ6.

limitations: No evaluator rerun or clean build.
Structural validator pass does not validate M015 convergence credibility.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.
